questions.question: What was total revenue in 2025?
questions.answer: 2025 total revenue: 359,108,160.59 USD. Net of discounts, completed orders only (cancelled and returned excluded). Based on 24,793 order lines dated 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31.

questions.question: What was the gross margin in the North region in Q1 2026?
questions.answer: North gross margin Q1 2026: 30.3%. Revenue 20,778,628.74 USD, COGS 14,477,482.48 USD, gross profit 6,301,146.26 USD. Based on completed orders only (order_lines), dated 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31, region by customer region. No comparison to other periods done; not asked.

questions.question: What was the average discount rate for Enterprise customers in Q3 2026?
questions.answer: Enterprise discount rate Q3 2026: 8.03%. Metric definition used: discount share of revenue before discount. Discount 6,816,009.36 USD on 84,880,966.68 USD pre-discount revenue, 2,817 order lines. Simple average of line discount_pct is 8.00%, near-identical. Compare: Mid-Market 5.00%, SMB 3.96%. Source: completed orders in order_lines, 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30.

questions.question: How much revenue did the Electronics category generate in 2025?
questions.answer: Electronics generated 77,988,285.78 USD net revenue in 2025. Net of discounts, completed orders only (cancelled and returned excluded). Based on 3,564 order lines dated 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 in order_lines.

questions.question: What was the operating margin in Q3 2026?
questions.answer: Operating margin Q3 2026: 4.67%. Operating profit $4,854,496.99 on revenue $103,925,364.51. Costs: COGS $78,457,837.86 (gross margin 24.51%), operating expenses $20,613,029.66. Based on completed orders (order_lines) dated 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30, and expenses for Jul-Sep 2026, all regions. No comparison with prior period done.

questions.question: Which product category brought in the most revenue in 2025?
questions.answer: Metals brought most revenue in 2025: $174,853,963.85, 48.7% of $359,108,160.59 total. Electronics second: $77,988,285.78 (21.7%). Then Tools $39,372,573.60, Plastics $29,519,854.17, Chemicals $28,304,459.54, Packaging $9,069,023.65. Basis: net revenue after discount, completed orders only, order dates 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, USD.
